name: omp-enhance
description: First-principles YAML role conditioning, Markov handoff, and long-job orchestration extension for Oh My Pi

defaultRole.description: Role activated automatically on session start (use 'off' to disable)

showStatusBar.description: Show active role and bound model badge in the OMP status bar

supervisorEnabled.description: Enable periodic supervisor monitoring for long-running sessions and background jobs

supervisorModel.description: Model or OMP role (@advisor, @smol, @slow, inherit, or provider/model-id) for supervisor

supervisorThinking.description: Thinking effort level for periodic supervisor inspections

supervisorInitialDelaySec.description: Seconds before the first supervisor check triggers on a running task

flowMaxRepairRounds.description: Default maximum automatic repair rounds in /flow

flowRoutingMode.description: How foreground general dispatches multi-role flows: ask first (default), auto, or manual

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run check:loc && bun run test
